threat_event: Remote attacker uses a stolen on-call operator VPN password and the shared HMI account to open spillway gates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT VPN profile uses passwords only; shared HMI operator account; gates operable from the HMI after hours
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a access control; 9.3b access control; Form 3 Q18g-18h); C-DAMS-R02 (12.3(b)(4)(ii); 12.3(b)(4)(xi))
existing_controls: Control room staffed 06:00-22:00; reservoir level alarms page the on-call operator; local gate panels can override
treatment_plan: MFA on the OT VPN through a hardened jump host; named HMI accounts; remote gate commands disabled until MFA is live (view-only after hours)

threat_event: Remote attacker trips or misoperates turbine units and governors, causing water hammer or unit damage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Same remote path as R-001; governors reachable from the control LAN
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a access control and functional segregation; Form 3 Q18g)
existing_controls: Unit protection relays trip on overspeed; operators can isolate units locally
treatment_plan: Same fix as R-001; segment unit controllers from the HMI VLAN with allow-listed protocols

threat_event: Compromise of the SCADA integrator's always-on remote connection gives an attacker persistent OT access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor connection; no MFA; no logging or weekly review
existing_controls: Vendor contract with a confidentiality clause
treatment_plan: Replace always-on access with on-demand sessions approved by the Operations Supervisor, MFA, session recording, and weekly log review

threat_event: Governor and excitation vendor's remote tool is compromised and used to change unit settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor remote tool installed on the engineering workstation; no approval step
existing_controls: Vendor uses named technicians
treatment_plan: Remove the resident tool; route vendor sessions through the same approved jump host as R-003

threat_event: Ransomware in the corporate network crosses into OT through the dual-homed engineering workstation and broad firewall rules, encrypting the HMI servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual-homed engineering workstation; permissive IT-to-OT rules; no EDR in OT
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a access control and functional segregation; Form 3 Q11a-11b; Q22)
existing_controls: Corporate EDR; firewall between IT and OT
treatment_plan: Remove the corporate interface from the engineering workstation; rebuild OT firewall rules to allow-list only historian replication; OT-compatible malware protection

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts corporate systems and the attacker steals CEII for extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CEII in general file shares; flat corporate network
existing_controls: EDR; MFA; daily cloud backups
treatment_plan: Move CEII to a restricted library (R-017); immutable backups; 24x7 EDR alert monitoring by the MSP

threat_event: Attacker activity in the OT network goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT logging, monitoring, or anomaly detection
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a intrusion detection and response; Form 3 Q14a-14c)
existing_controls: None in OT
treatment_plan: Forward OT firewall, VPN, HMI, and historian logs to the log workspace; passive OT network monitoring sensor; daily review by operations and weekly review by the Controls Engineer

threat_event: Attacker exploits known vulnerabilities in the unsupported operating system on the HMI servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMI servers past vendor support; no OT patch process; no vulnerability assessment
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a system lifecycle; 9.3b vulnerability assessment; Form 3 Q15; Q18i)
existing_controls: Servers are behind the OT firewall
treatment_plan: SCADA platform upgrade to a supported operating system; first OT vulnerability assessment; quarterly OT patch review with the integrator

threat_event: Control system cannot be rebuilt after a failure or attack because PLC and HMI backups are stale, stored on the same network, and never tested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Irregular backups to an OT NAS; no offline copy; no restore test; no OT recovery procedure
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a restoration and recovery; Form 3 Q16)
existing_controls: Vendor keeps original project files from 2018
treatment_plan: Monthly and post-change backups of PLC logic and HMI projects to an offline, write-protected copy and the cloud vault; annual restore test on a spare PLC; written OT recovery procedure

threat_event: Malware reaches the OT network on a technician's USB drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No removable media policy; USB ports open on HMIs and the engineering workstation
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Removable media policy (POL-05); scanning kiosk; USB port control on OT workstations

threat_event: Someone on the control LAN uses default passwords on the spillway gate local panel web interfaces to change gate settings
threat_source: Insider or intruder with network access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manufacturer default passwords on 2 of 4 local panels (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Panels are on the control LAN only; spillway is fenced and locked
treatment_plan: Change default passwords now; disable the web interface where not needed; add to baseline checks

threat_event: Attacker logs into an upstream gauge cellular modem with the default password and feeds false river levels into flood operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords on 2 internet-reachable cellular modems (found in P07 testing)
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a general, remote connections; Form 3 Q12b); C-DAMS-R02 (12.3(b)(4)(viii))
existing_controls: Operators compare gauge readings with the public stream gauge downstream
treatment_plan: Change passwords; restrict modem access to a private cellular APN; alert on gauge disagreement

threat_event: Intruder on foot reaches the spillway gate hoists or local control panels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Spillway deck fence line has one camera blind spot; night patrols every 4 hours
existing_controls: Fencing; locked gates; cameras; night patrols
treatment_plan: Add a camera to cover the blind spot; update the Security Assessment (gap 2)

threat_event: A current or former operator uses the shared operator password to misoperate gates remotely
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared HMI and OT VPN passwords not changed when operators leave (2 departures since 2024)
existing_controls: Background checks at hire
treatment_plan: Rotate shared passwords now; named accounts (R-001); OT access removal on the termination checklist

threat_event: FERC finds the Security Plan and Security Assessment out of date and the 2025 certification letter inaccurate, and issues a directive or sanction
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual updates lapsed after 2022; letter certified compliance; no Section 9 response
existing_controls: Letters filed on time each year
treatment_plan: Send a corrected statement and plan and schedule to the Regional Engineer by 2026-09-30; update the Security Assessment and Security Plan before the 2026-11-17 inspection

threat_event: A cyber attack on gate or unit controls is not escalated to the EAP or reported to the Regional Engineer on time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT cyber incident procedure; Internal Emergency Response sub-element covers physical threats only
existing_controls: EAP notification charts; operators know 12.10 for physical conditions
treatment_plan: P08 runbook; add cyber triggers to the Internal Emergency Response sub-element; annual tabletop with the sheriff and county emergency management

threat_event: CEII such as inundation maps and gate control drawings is disclosed from open file shares and used to plan an attack
threat_source: Outsider using leaked documents; careless insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CEII readable by all 187 staff, including seasonal recreation workers; no marking
existing_controls: Security Assessment and Security Plan kept in a locked cabinet in paper
treatment_plan: Restricted CEII library with named access and marking (POL-04); remove CEII from general shares

threat_event: Hurricane cuts commercial power and communications during flood operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single fiber path to the site; control room radio is the only backup
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 7.2 communication procedures and redundancies); C-DAMS-R02 (12.54(c))
existing_controls: Standby diesel load-tested annually; manual gate operation; staff stay on site during named storms
treatment_plan: Satellite phone and cellular failover at the control room; document redundant communications in the Security Plan

threat_event: Hurricane damages powerhouse electrical equipment and stops generation for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Critical spares list is informal; switchyard equipment has long lead times
existing_controls: Property and business interruption insurance
treatment_plan: Keep insurance; build a critical spares inventory as part of the Group 2 rapid recovery practice

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects an offtaker settlement or field services payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment changes accepted by email; finance staff not trained on BEC
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank changes; BEC training for finance

threat_event: Offtaker telemetry link is disrupted or spoofed, causing dispatch errors and contract penalties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RTU on a leased circuit with no integrity checks
existing_controls: Operators confirm schedules by phone
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Vice President of Operations: residual risk Low; revisit with the offtaker at the next RTU upgrade

threat_event: Identity provider administrator account is taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three administrators with standing access
existing_controls: Hardware security keys for all administrators; sign-in alerts
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Vice President of Operations: residual risk Low

threat_event: Instrumentation data platform vendor has an outage or breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS platform for trend analysis
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; raw data stays in the OT historian
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review (P09); contract notice terms

threat_event: Staff rely on the AI anomaly module and miss a developing seepage or piezometer anomaly
threat_source: AI model error and automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot in shadow mode; proposal to reduce manual weekly reviews
existing_controls: Manual weekly review against trigger points continues
treatment_plan: Keep manual reviews until the P10 acceptance tests pass; AI alerts never replace trigger-point checks

threat_event: Staff paste CEII or security details into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list; no training on CEII
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-05 generative AI rule; approved enterprise assistant without CEII (P10 AI-002)

threat_event: Operators fall for a pretext call or email asking them to change gate settings or install software
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No role-based OT security training
existing_controls: Operators verify gate orders against the operating plan
treatment_plan: Annual role-based control system security training before OT access

threat_event: Suspicious activity (drone overflight, photography of the spillway) is not reported, so FERC and law enforcement miss early warning
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written suspicious activity procedure; not a member of the HSIN Dams portal
existing_controls: Security officers log incidents in a paper logbook
treatment_plan: Suspicious activity procedure using the Appendix B categories; report to the Regional Office usually within one working day; HSIN membership

threat_event: Compromised vendor firmware or software update is installed on unit or gate controllers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Updates installed without hash or signature checks
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a coordination, acquisition standards; Form 3 Q32a)
existing_controls: Updates done by vendor technicians on site
treatment_plan: Security terms in vendor contracts; verify update integrity; change approval by the Plant Manager

threat_event: Only one person can restore PLC logic and SCADA configuration, delaying recovery
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single Controls Engineer; little written procedure
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 9.3a information security coordination and responsibilities)
existing_controls: Integrator support contract
treatment_plan: Cross-train one I&C technician; written recovery steps (R-009)

threat_event: Denial of service on the site internet link blocks after-hours remote monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet circuit
existing_controls: Critical alarms page the on-call operator over an independent cellular dialer
treatment_plan: Cellular failover (same work as R-018)

threat_event: Recreation reservation vendor breach exposes customer personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; company outside the vendor's controls
existing_controls: Vendor-hosted payments; contract breach-notice clause
treatment_plan: Keep vendor breach-notice and indemnity terms; review vendor assurance annually

threat_event: Employee personal information is exposed through payroll SaaS or a phished HR mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR mailbox holds scanned employee documents
existing_controls: MFA; payroll vendor SOC 2
treatment_plan: Move scanned documents into the payroll SaaS; delete from the mailbox

threat_event: Boat-borne intruder approaches the spillway or intake at night
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Log boom upstream of the spillway; no camera on the intake
existing_controls: Log boom; night patrols; lighting
treatment_plan: Intake camera with the R-013 camera project; consider in the Security Assessment update
